text: PhilHealth's array of health and welfare programs focuses on enhancing well-being and preparedness among its members. This includes initiatives like the PhilHealthy Movement, corporate events such as PhilHealthy Team Day, PhilHealth Family Day, and One PhilHealth Team Day, various medical programs, and disaster and emergency preparedness initiatives. In addition, the corporation is engaged in various learning and development programs. The Universal Healthcare Bill (UHB), signed into law by Filipino President Rodrigo Duterte in early 2019, marked a pivotal expansion in PhilHealth’s mandate. This legislation aims to include all citizens within the PhilHealth system, not just those formally employed, thereby extending its reach to informal workers and the unemployed.
